categories.main_business_segments: GreenTech Environmental Co., Ltd. primarily operates in water pollution control, wastewater treatment and reuse, seawater desalination, collection and utilization of rainwater, brackish water, and mine water, unconventional water source utilization technology R&D, resource recycling consulting, environmental emergency management, water environment pollution prevention, environmental protection equipment manufacturing and sales, software development, and intelligent water system development.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary membrane technologies including GTMOST® membrane universal platform technology, membrane anti-fouling technology, precise dosing technology, direct coupling technology, and Crysacter crystallization softening technology. It integrates AI-driven smart water plant operation via its Water Radish® AI intelligent body and modular, industrialized production of smart water treatment units called New Water Island®. The company emphasizes productization, AI digitization, and resource recovery as its strategic technological pillars.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include municipal governments, industrial enterprises, and industrial parks, with a focus on sectors such as photovoltaics, printed circuit boards (PCB), chemical fiber, and dyeing industries. The company serves both To B (industrial) and To G (municipal) markets, providing high-quality drinking water, wastewater resource recovery, and smart water plant operation services.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant projects in Beijing, Tianjin, Hebei, Jiangsu, Guangdong, and other provinces. It also actively expands overseas markets including the Middle East, Southeast Asia, North Africa, and Europe, with subsidiaries and partnerships in Hong Kong, Singapore, British Virgin Islands, and other locations.
categories.supply_chain_position: GreenTech Environmental operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the water treatment supply chain, providing water treatment technology solutions, manufacturing smart water treatment equipment, and offering operation and maintenance services. It also produces and sells resource recovery products derived from wastewater.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on 'resource recovery, AI digitization, and productization.' It invests heavily in R&D to advance membrane technologies, AI-driven smart operation platforms, and modular product development. Collaborations with universities and research institutes support innovation in advanced oxidation, crystallization softening, and digital twin technologies. The company aims to enhance unmanned operation capabilities and expand scalable, standardized smart water treatment products.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through sales of smart water treatment equipment (New Water Island®), sales of process package products, software sales of the Water Radish® AI intelligent platform, production and sale of wastewater resource recovery products, and operation and maintenance service fees. The company also engages in investment, construction, and operation projects, earning income from water sales and service fees.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: GreenTech Environmental is recognized as a leading expert in deep water treatment and wastewater resource recovery in China, holding a strong market position supported by proprietary technologies and extensive project experience. It competes in a technology-driven market with increasing competition due to policy support and industry growth. The company has received multiple national awards and certifications, reinforcing its competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 617.1 million, a 7.74% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 66.8 million, a slight decrease of 5.62%. Total assets reached RMB 2.3 billion, growing 8.59% from the previous year. The company maintains stable cash flow and continues to invest in R&D, with a focus on sustainable growth and profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: GreenTech Environmental differentiates itself through its integrated 'resource recovery, AI digitization, and productization' strategy, offering modular, factory-produced smart water treatment units that enable unmanned, efficient operation. Its Water Radish® AI platform provides autonomous process optimization and fault diagnosis, reducing operational costs and enhancing reliability. The company’s proprietary membrane technologies and process packages deliver high-quality water solutions that address water scarcity, environmental capacity, safety, and cost challenges for industrial and municipal clients.
